run_f_gold: run f_gold to find the starting index of the maximum average subarray of length k
test_f_gold: test f_gold with an array, its length n, and subarray size k to verify correct index
refactor_f_gold: refactor f_gold to use a sliding window instead of a cumulative sum array
review_f_gold: review f_gold which returns the start index of the max average subarray of size k
summarize_f_gold: summarize f_gold that computes the starting index of the maximum average subarray using cumulative sums
